My journey

I started as a social media manager in Uganda. I had a phone full of drafts, a content calendar and a lot of curiosity. Every post taught me something about people: what makes them stop, what makes them care and what makes them come back.

Then I stepped into e-commerce. I ran online stores for beauty, fashion and perfume brands, from product pages to getting found on Google to the first sale of the day. That was where I learned that a beautiful brand still needs a reason to click “buy.”

From stores I moved into campaigns. In Dubai I helped a home-services business turn attention into real customers and booked jobs. Then I took on five brands at once, across law, travel, HR, wellness and social, each with its own audience and its own voice.

Today I set the strategy and lead the team. As Marketing Manager at CRWD Dubai, I guide marketing teams and campaigns for brands across the UAE. I set the vision, and directors, editors and designers bring it to life. AI now works alongside us, helping brands get found faster, create more and grow with the right tools.

I’m proud of every brand that trusted me along the way. Each one taught me something, and each one is part of this story.

How I work

Plan first. Then launch.

  1. 01

    Listen

    I start with the customer: who buys, why, and what stops them.

  2. 02

    Plan

    I set the marketing plan: who to talk to, where, what to spend and what success looks like.

  3. 03

    Brand & design

    I shape how the brand looks and sounds, and lead the designers who make it.

  4. 04

    Launch

    I launch the campaign: posts, influencers, ads and the dates they go live.

  5. 05

    Improve

    I watch what sells, drop what doesn’t and spend more on what works.
